en.caps.conflict: The configuration changed in another surface; reloaded — please retry.
en.caps.disable.hint: A disabled provider leaves the composer model picker and the subagent selection immediately; its configuration is archived and can be restored at any time.
en.caps.efforts.inheritHint: Follows the built-in catalog; a hand-declared model has nothing to follow, which behaves like no reasoning.
en.caps.efforts.levelsHint: Check the levels the model supports and fill in the wire value each one sends.
en.caps.efforts.noneHint: Declare this model as non-reasoning (reasoningEfforts: false); the model picker stops offering thinking levels.
en.caps.empty: No editable model catalog for this provider yet. Add model rows in the catalog above, then come back here to declare capabilities per model.
en.caps.error.baseProfile: The composition layer also declares this provider, so disabling cannot take it down; the action is not offered.
en.caps.error.partialEnable: Enabled, but clearing the archive failed: {error}
en.caps.error.routeExists: The provider already has a newer configuration; the archive cannot be restored. Remove the current configuration first, then enable.
en.caps.error.unavailable: Cannot toggle: the plugin archive settings entry is not served.
en.caps.footer.hint: These providers have archived configurations; enabling restores the original profile and puts it back into the model picker and the subagent selection.
en.caps.footer.title: Disabled providers
en.caps.hint: Declare reasoning efforts per catalog model; saving writes the settings document and applies immediately.
en.caps.invalid.offOnly: Declare at least one level beyond off, or switch to "No reasoning".
en.caps.invalid.wire: Level {level} needs a non-empty wire value.
en.caps.preset.common: Fill the common low / medium / high
en.caps.readOnly: The settings document is read-only; changes are disabled.
en.caps.seat.conflict: The Model capabilities panel is not mounted: another plugin ({plugin}) holds the provider-card extension seat, which renders one extension area per provider card. The panel returns as soon as that plugin is unloaded.
en.caps.staleDraft: The configuration changed in another surface; your unsaved changes are kept and re-checked when you save.
en.caps.state.disabled: This provider is disabled: its models are absent from the composer picker and the subagent selection. The configuration is archived; enabling restores it.
en.caps.title: Model capabilities
en.caps.wire.label: Wire value
en.caps.wire.offHint: off may stay empty: "supported, but send nothing when chosen".
